news.title: Substack Announces Rollout Of Platform Podcast Sponsorships
Substack’s influencer marketing era has arrived

bullets: Identify the most valuable opportunities to improve creator earnings and build a focused roadmap with clear goals and trade-offs.
Develop gifting experiences that help readers support creators, share value with others and strengthen paid communities.
Improve retention, renewal and win-back experiences, partnering with Growth on offers and subscription lifecycle improvements.
Make payment journeys clearer and more effective across web and mobile, from plan selection and checkout through successful payment and renewal.
Explore new monetization pathways, including commerce, and help shape future opportunities in ads as the business evolves.
Set the product direction. Use conversations with publishers and advertisers, product data, and company priorities to build a roadmap across near-term experiments and longer-term…
Build distinctive sponsorship experiences. Develop formats that fit naturally into Substack across email, web, and app, including sponsorships that help readers discover writers…
Own the advertiser experience. Make it easy for brands and agencies to discover relevant publications, plan and book campaigns, manage creative approvals, and understand results.…
Make sponsorships work for publishers. Create simple tools to opt in, set preferences, approve opportunities, manage placements, and track earnings. Preserve publishers’ control…
Build the marketplace and operating foundation. Partner with Engineering and Ad Operations on matching, inventory forecasting, campaign delivery, pacing, billing, and payouts.…
